errors.evidence: The description fails to mention that the bars are sorted in ascending order of their percentage values, which is a key structural feature of the chart that highlights the ranking of the different factors.

errors.evidence: The description states that the values are labeled directly on the bars, but they are actually located to the right of the end of each bar.
